payload.title: omp isolated copy can run from the line only while the dispatcher's checkout is clean
payload.body: Built by omp-implementer-worktree of remaining-gaps: a dispatcher tool_call handler sets isolated:true on implementer spawns and install records task.isolation.enabled true, apply false, merge branch; the copy is cut from the dispatcher's HEAD (measured on omp 18.4.9: HEAD ab0a949 = main, not the line tip 4b82bc1; no ref can be given). NOT built: running the copy from the line. Measured possible while the dispatcher's checkout is CLEAN: a session_start handler in the sub session (ctx.agent.kind==='sub', ctx.cwd the copy) can 'git checkout --detach <line>' in the copy (it sees the source refs), after which omp fetches the agent's own commits to omp/task/<id> (line IS ancestor, main git status unchanged). With a DIRTY dispatcher checkout (uncommitted or untracked files) omp replays the agent's commits against the baseline WIP onto the dispatcher's HEAD: the branch lost the line history and the agent's hashes. Still needed for that: a way to hand the line tip to the child (the copy's cwd is not the dispatcher's, so cratylus plan show there may not find the plan) and a clean-checkout guard at dispatch.
